theme: Two days to Croatia — close the open loops before Tuesday.
greeting: The calendar's nearly empty today, Dan, but the list isn't. This is the last clear runway before the Tuesday flight and the kid handoff, and a handful of trip bookings are still best closed from dry land.

needsAttention.title: Halloween: St Pete or Maine
needsAttention.detail: The call was due yesterday and it's a genuine blocker — the Oct 18–Nov 1 rotation booking fires while you're in Croatia. One decision, three downstream bookings; settle it before Tuesday rather than from the boat.

needsAttention.title: Confirm Croatia checked bags in writing
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags on the Eurowings Discover legs. Pull it up on the operating carrier's site with the record locator and buy bags online now — counter fees run far higher, and two 55L duffels won't pass as carry-on.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat night + transfer, Sept 19
needsAttention.detail: Still unbooked: one night in Cavtat after the charter ends at Komolac, plus the noon transfer over. Onboard connectivity is poor, so this has to happen before you fly Tuesday.

needsAttention.title: St Pete lodging, Sept 20–22
needsAttention.detail: Two nights are still open between the TPA landing and the Tuesday kid pickup. Book it before you leave so it isn't a jet-lagged scramble.

needsAttention.title: Message the Nautilus instructor
needsAttention.detail: Confirm the Saturday boarding time and location and line up the Sept 19 return transfer now — bandwidth drops sharply once you're underway.

needsAttention.title: Reply to Andrew Kaufmann
needsAttention.detail: A LinkedIn InMail landed today: his email to you bounced, he's checking whether you're still at KPMG, and he'd welcome the chance to reconnect. New and awaiting a reply.

flagged.title: Andrew Kaufmann InMail
flagged.detail: Networking reconnect via LinkedIn — asking if you're still at KPMG, welcomes the opportunity.

inbox.noise: The rest is Airbnb check-in back-and-forth for the St Pete stay.
inbox.clear: Inbox is otherwise quiet — nothing else awaiting your reply.

resolved.title: UN PRI call with Conor Kehoe
resolved.detail: You replied Sept 4 to push it past your trip and Kate confirmed she'll reopen the diary when you're back — nothing owed now.

recipe.title: Kabocha squash, yukon gold potatoes & cipolline
recipe.why: Autumn squash and cipolline onions are at their peak now, made for a slow, earthy roast as the evenings cool.

tasks.title: Finish the remaining Nautilus Masterclass videos
Car hedge — keep the refundable SUV unless Mike's car is confirmed en route
Build & pack the travel larder bin
Buy EU plug adapters + a US power strip

acts.line: The 9 AM Sunday review with Mike was the only thing on the calendar — a fifteen-minute board sweep.
Open time, and the last real runway to close the Croatia bookings before Tuesday's flight.
The girls are with you and Mike tonight; both the handoff to Jen and your flight land on Tuesday.
